input.answer: If I have to choose one, it's Harel, the "כספי (שקלי)" track: Harel is a name I know, it shows 0% in shares and 0% in foreign currency, it's in shekels, and it shows 4.25% over 3 years. But I'm not sure it's as safe as my deposit or that it really earns more, so I won't sign anything until I ask you and the bank.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Most of them mean nothing to me ('עוקב מדד S&P 500', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש', 'כספי (שקלי)'). I saw 'אג"ח ממשלתית 3', which sounded safe, but I didn't know whether pressing it would change the page, so I left it and kept scrolling.

Every row has two percentages for fees, two for 'חשיפה', two for returns, and the money managed, plus a coloured circle. I couldn't tell which number matters. In the end I only looked at the names, the 0% shares, and the return.
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no number, so I couldn't compare them, for example Harel 'אג"ח סחיר', which otherwise looked safe.

stuck.where: Choosing between 'כספי (שקלי)' and 'אג"ח סחיר' at Harel
stuck.why: Both show 0% shares. I know government bonds are safe, but it doesn't say 'ממשלתי' here, and I don't know what 'סחיר' or 'כספי' means for this.

findings.what: The page is dark: black background with grey and turquoise letters. Even with the screen enlarged it was hard on my eyes, and the grey writing is very pale.
It opens with buttons full of English letters and words like 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' and 'מניות'. It made me feel the page isn't for someone like me.
Too many numbers in every row, with no sentence explaining what they mean. It made me nervous.
Many tracks show only 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so I can't compare them.
Nothing says whether you can lose money in a track, or how it compares with a deposit, which is what I came to find out.
The management fee is shown on 'החיסכון'. I pay nothing like that on my deposit, and I couldn't tell whether 0.57% a year eats up the return.
The table is very long (143 tracks). I got tired around the sixth screen and didn't get to the other companies.
'מקור' is a site I've never heard of. Only the insurance company names reassured me a bit.
